app_recommendations: Incorporate the multi-tier doneness chart in the app engine: Rare (120°F), Medium-Rare (130°F), Medium (140°F–145°F), Medium-Well (150°F), and Well-Done (160°F), noting that FDA safe baseline is 145°F with a 3-minute rest.
Enforce resting rules based on steak thickness: 5 minutes per inch of thickness (or 10 minutes per pound) before carving to prevent juice loss.
For steaks over 1.5 inches thick, default to recommending the reverse sear (250°F oven then smoking-hot sear) to eliminate gray banding and ensure edge-to-edge even doneness.
Always instruct users to carve fibrous steaks (flank, skirt, flat iron) against the grain at a 45-degree angle to shorten muscle fibers.
